policy.purpose: Inspect a small set of already-curated prototypes and materialize only the cases that remain graphically simple after duplicate and ambiguity review.
policy.proof: exact phonetics != lexical obviousness != visual plausibility != spontaneous namability != clinical validation
policy.storage: New SVG stimuli remain under assets/research and are inspection stimuli, not registered production assets.
policy.naming: Every inspected item keeps spontaneousNamingRisk unknown, humanNamingEvidence none and clinicalEvidence none.

entries.duplicateInspection: No registered asset, research filename match or earlier prototype for pelle was found in the current repository tree or representation queue.
entries.graphicInspection: A single garden shovel stays readable with only handle, shaft and blade. The unresolved lexical competitor is bêche rather than a parasitic scene element.

entries.duplicateInspection: No registered radis asset or prior radis research prototype was found.
entries.graphicInspection: The bulb plus a small leafy crown gives a compact stimulus. Navet/betterave/légume remain plausible readings but no extra context is needed.

entries.duplicateInspection: No registered or research carré stimulus was found; existing geometric conventions do not duplicate this lexical route.
entries.graphicInspection: A single square is maximally sparse. The main uncertainty is whether a participant says carré, forme or rectangle despite equal sides.

entries.duplicateInspection: The repository contains a tour/chess research stimulus but no bishop/fou duplicate; the two chess-piece concepts are distinct.
entries.graphicInspection: The bishop silhouette and diagonal notch are simple enough to isolate the chess sense of fou. Pièce/pion/reine remain naming competitors to measure later.
A minimal wolf silhouette collapses toward chien; adding forest, moon or aggressive pose adds narrative cues without guaranteeing loup. Rework is preferable to a weak v1 asset.
The hook is necessary to signal fishing but then hameçon/appât dominate; removing it makes the lure look like an arbitrary small object. No clean minimal v1 was justified.

Visible peaches make the tree species inferable but also make pêche/fruits/arbre strong responses; without fruit the species is lost. The concept remains promising but needs a naming experiment before asset production.
Terrine and sliced-meat depictions remain at least as likely to elicit terrine, charcuterie or viande; adding bread or packaging only adds distractors. No asset was created.
